dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly falcate trailing edge characterized by a smooth, deep concave spline originating at the apex and extending to the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a small pixel radius, classified as obtuse in shape.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Convex anterior margin rising at an approximate 50-degree angle relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.8:1 ratio of maximum pixel base width to maximum vertical pixel height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Minor irregular nicks visible on the lower portion of the trailing edge; subtle light-colored dermal abrasions on the upper lateral surface of the fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive bicolor pigmentation featuring a dark primary fin surface contrasting with a prominent, light-gray wedge extending posteriorly from the fin base.
